The frame consists of sturdy, flat planks forming the legs, armrests, and back support, while the cushions appear thick and comfortable.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Vanity Stool
description: A compact, contemporary upholstered vanity stool or accent chair featuring a rounded seat and a low, curved backrest, supported by thick, splayed wooden legs.

description: A wooden side chair featuring a woven rush seat and a distinctive circular carved backrest. The frame is crafted from dark, reddish-brown wood, with the front leg exhibiting a unique reeded detail near the foot. The rear legs are gently tapered and slightly splayed for stability. The backrest is a prominent design element, featuring a concentric spiral carving.

name: Modern Upholstered Swivel Accent Chair
description: A modern, round upholstered chair featuring a drum-shaped base and a low, curved backrest. The main body is covered in a light grey textured fabric, while the backrest and base are finished in a smooth, light beige material, likely faux leather.

name: Textured Fabric Organic Modern Lounge Chair
description: A single-person seating unit, fully upholstered in a textured fabric, featuring a high, curved backrest, integrated armrests, and a rounded base. It is accompanied by a small, rectangular lumbar pillow.

name: Distressed Leather Swivel Office Chair
description: A classic executive-style office chair upholstered in light brown distressed leather. It features a high back, sloped and padded armrests, and a deep seat, all covered in the same tactile leather. The chair rests on a five-star base made of distressed light-colored wood, equipped with dark casters featuring brass accents, allowing for easy mobility. The visible swivel mechanism indicates functional adjustability.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Bench with Brass Frame
description: A contemporary bench featuring a long, capsule-shaped upholstered seat covered in a light, textured boucle-style fabric, supported by a slender golden metal frame with four thin legs.

name: Modern Upholstered Dining Armchair with Curved Back
description: A modern dining chair featuring a unique curved backrest that seamlessly transitions into integrated armrests, fully upholstered in a light brown or taupe textured bouclé fabric. The seat cushion is also upholstered in the same material. The chair is supported by four slender, tapered legs crafted from dark-stained wood.

name: Modern Brass and Fabric Bolster Chaise Lounge
description: A modern and sculptural chaise lounge featuring multiple horizontal bolster cushions upholstered in a light beige fabric, resting on a sleek, curved metal base with a brushed brass finish. One end has an additional, slightly larger bolster cushion positioned vertically to serve as a headrest or armrest.

name: Modern Upholstered Chaise Lounge
description: A sleek, modern chaise lounge featuring grey upholstery, a low backrest, and a single armrest on the left side, supported by a minimalist black metal frame with tapered legs. It comes with two decorative pillows and a plaid throw blanket.

name: Traditional Tufted Leather Dining Armchair
description: This is a traditional style armchair featuring a solid wood frame with an upholstered seat and a deeply tufted backrest. The upholstery appears to be a reddish-brown leather or faux leather, secured with individual nailhead trim along the edges of the seat and the back panel. The wooden frame has turned arm supports and decorative carving on the top rail of the backrest. The front legs exhibit a gentle S-curve (cabriole-like) shape, while the back legs are straight, connected by stretcher bars.

name: Neoclassical Tufted Dining Chair
description: A Neoclassical style dining chair featuring a carved wooden frame, dark button-tufted upholstery on the backrest, and a matching upholstered seat. The chair is accented with gold trim and brass nailhead detailing along the edges of the upholstery. The backrest has an ornate, curved top, and the legs are tapered.

name: Wooden Kids Learning Tower
description: A light-toned wooden structure designed to safely elevate a child to counter height. It features two steps for easy climbing, an enclosed top platform with horizontal safety rails, and a metal latch mechanism on one side that suggests it might be foldable or adjustable. The design is simple, minimalist, and functional, with cut-out handholds on the side panels.

name: Contemporary Wood Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat and Back
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring a solid wood frame with a rich, warm brown finish. Both the seat and the backrest are upholstered in a dark gray, textured fabric. The backrest has a gently curved top edge, complementing the straight lines of the frame and legs. The chair is designed with a simple, functional aesthetic, suitable for modern interior settings.

name: Round Boucle Wood Ottoman
description: A contemporary round ottoman featuring a plush, off-white boucle fabric cushion set within a curved light wood frame. The wooden frame acts as both a base and partial enclosure for the upholstered top, creating a modern, sculptural aesthetic.

name: Mid-Century Modern Red Leather Armchair
description: A stylish Mid-Century Modern inspired armchair upholstered in rich red leather. The chair features a comfortable, rounded silhouette with broad track arms and a slightly reclined back. It stands on four slender, tapered dark wood legs that splay slightly, giving it a light and elegant appearance. The seat cushion is loose, and the overall construction suggests a compact yet inviting form.

name: Contemporary Black Faux Leather Armchair with Bentwood Accents
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a curved back and seat upholstered in black faux leather, complemented by bentwood armrests and splayed legs in a rich, warm wood tone. The design incorporates an open space between the backrest and seat, creating a visually light and modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Upholstered Armchair with Exposed Wood Frame
description: A modern upholstered armchair featuring a rounded back and arms that flow into a cohesive form. The chair is covered in a light beige textured fabric, complemented by a single dark brown accent cushion. An exposed dark wood frame extends from the sides, forming the back support and tapering into the legs. Subtle brass-toned metal accents are integrated where the wooden frame meets the upholstered body, adding a touch of contemporary elegance. The overall design suggests comfort combined with refined aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Tan Leather Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a cohesive, gently curved shell for the backrest and integrated armrests, upholstered in a smooth, tan-colored leather. The seat cushion is also upholstered in matching leather. The entire upholstered body appears to rest upon a dark-finished, possibly metal or wood, exposed frame with four tapered legs.

name: Brown Faux Leather Cantilever Office Chair
description: A modern cantilever office chair featuring brown faux leather upholstery and a chrome-plated steel frame. The chair includes a high, ergonomically curved backrest and padded armrests, providing comfortable support. Its sleek design makes it suitable for contemporary office or conference room settings.

name: Mid-Century Modern Dining Chair with Boucle Upholstery
description: A stylish mid-century modern dining chair featuring a sculpted wooden frame and off-white boucle upholstery. The chair's frame is made from warm-toned wood with elegantly curved back supports and tapered legs. Both the seat and the organically shaped backrest are generously padded and covered in a textured, soft boucle fabric, providing a comfortable and visually appealing seating option. The design emphasizes organic forms and natural materials, typical of Scandinavian and mid-century aesthetics.

name: Bentwood Settee with Cane Seat and Fan Back
description: A classic two-seater bentwood settee featuring a dark wood frame, a woven cane seat, and an intricately designed fan-back rest. The settee has elegantly curved armrests and four tapered legs, characteristic of traditional bentwood craftsmanship.

name: Wooden Cane Lounge Chair
description: A vintage or Mid-Century Modern lounge chair constructed from a solid wooden frame with woven cane panels for the seat and backrest. The chair features a reclined back, wide, flat armrests, and robust, splayed legs. The wood exhibits a warm, medium brown tone, and the cane weaving is in a traditional open-mesh pattern. The overall design emphasizes a relaxed, comfortable posture.

name: Contemporary Boucle Lounge Chair with Integrated Curved Backrest
description: A contemporary lounge chair upholstered in a textured cream boucle fabric. It features a unique design with a continuous, integrated curved backrest that wraps around the seating area, forming a partial armrest. The chair has a compact, armless base and a subtle piping detail along the edges of the curved backrest.

name: Traditional Curved Back Spindle Side Chair
description: A vintage-style wooden side chair with a curved top rail backrest and vertical spindles, integrated short arm extensions, and straight legs. The seat is solid wood with a dark finish. The chair is made from a warm medium-brown wood.

name: Modern Bentwood Dining Armchair with Upholstered Seat and Back
description: A modern dining armchair featuring a light-toned solid wood frame with elegantly curved back and armrests, and a distinct sled-style base. It includes a beige upholstered seat cushion and a matching upholstered back support.

name: Contemporary Rounded Wood and Bouclé Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a distinctive rounded wooden frame that cradles a deep, upholstered seat and backrest. The upholstery is a textured burnt orange fabric, complemented by a strip of dark blue fabric on the inner back. Brass accents include a large circular pivot point connecting the frame to the legs and a curved rod detail along the back.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Upholstered Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a sculptural form with a dark brown upholstered seat and backrest, cradled by an exposed dark wood frame that forms the armrests and legs. The fabric appears textured, and the wooden elements have a smooth, polished finish, contributing to an elegant and modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Armless Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A low-profile armless lounge chair featuring a distinctive dark, glossy wooden frame and plush brown upholstered cushions. The design emphasizes comfort with thick, rounded seat and back cushions that appear to float within the rigid frame. The frame itself has a sculptural quality, providing structural support and subtly integrated armrests.

name: Sculptural Wave-Textured Accent Chair
description: A striking black accent chair featuring a unique, wave-textured surface that gives it a fluid, sculptural appearance. The chair has a solid, monolithic form with a high back and a distinctive draped 'skirt' design extending to the floor, creating a sense of movement. The entire piece is rendered in a uniform dark tone, emphasizing its intricate texture and contemporary silhouette.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Chaise Lounge Sectional Component
description: A side profile view of a contemporary brown upholstered chaise lounge, likely a component of a larger sectional sofa. It features deep seating, integrated low-profile arms, and a backrest with distinct vertical channel tufting. The upholstery appears to be a soft fabric, possibly velvet or microfiber, in a rich chocolate brown hue. The base is simple with minimal block feet, suggesting a modern and grounded aesthetic. Overlaid measurements indicate a seat depth of 30 inches and an overall diagonal length of 57.2 inches, providing context for its proportions.

name: Mid-Century Style Cane Back Armchair
description: A stylish armchair featuring a sturdy wooden frame, a rectangular woven cane backrest, and a plush green upholstered seat. The chair has integrated wooden armrests and angled legs that contribute to its mid-century aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Leather Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a dark grey/black leather upholstered seat and a continuous curved backrest that seamlessly integrates into armrests. The chair is supported by four splayed, tapered legs crafted from dark-stained wood, suggesting a modern or mid-century inspired design aesthetic. Visible stitching details are present on the upholstery, highlighting the craftsmanship.

name: Organic Modern Swivel Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary swivel lounge chair with a sculptural, organic form, featuring a dark, molded shell and a richly patterned upholstered seat with a matching lumbar pillow.

name: Modern Wooden Armchair with Bolster Back
description: A modern armchair featuring a dark wood frame and black and off-white striped upholstery. The design includes a cylindrical bolster backrest and gently curved armrests that seamlessly connect to the front legs. The seat cushion is thick and upholstered in the same striped fabric, creating a striking visual contrast with the dark wood frame. The overall aesthetic is clean and contemporary with a graphic pattern.

name: Transitional Upholstered Armchair with Botanical Accents
description: An elegant upholstered armchair featuring a dark, curved wooden frame that wraps around the back and forms the armrests. The seat and inner backrest are upholstered in a light, neutral-toned fabric, with the inner back displaying vertical channel tufting. The outer back and side panels of the arms are adorned with a contrasting botanical pattern fabric in shades of green and gold. The chair stands on four tapered wooden legs, with the front legs incorporating turned wood detailing as part of the arm support. A decorative throw pillow in the matching botanical print fabric is included.

name: Modular Velvet Recliner Chaise Lounge
description: A brown velvet modular recliner chaise lounge with an adjustable segmented backrest, broad fixed armrests, and an integrated, pull-out footrest. It includes two rectangular scatter cushions for additional support.

name: Pink Velvet Tufted Chaise Lounge
description: A pink velvet tufted chaise lounge featuring a classic silhouette with one rolled arm and a gently curved backrest. The backrest is adorned with deep button tufting, creating a diamond pattern, while the seat is smooth with visible seam lines. It rests on dark, elegantly curved cabriole-style legs.

name: Mid-Century Modern Upholstered Armchair
description: A stylish Mid-Century Modern inspired upholstered armchair featuring a curved back and seat covered in a textured green fabric, complemented by an exposed wooden frame and flat, straight wooden armrests. The chair stands on four tapered wooden legs.

name: Patinated Bronze Rectangular Bench with Stepped Backrest Detail
description: This object is a contemporary, low-profile bench featuring a robust, rectangular form. Its construction material appears to be a patinated metal, possibly bronze or a bronze-finished alloy, exhibiting a rich, distressed reddish-brown hue. One end of the bench terminates with a smooth, continuous curve, while the opposite end is a sharp, right-angled corner. A distinctive design element is present on the top surface near the curved end: a recessed section forms a subtle, integrated backrest or raised lip, adding visual interest and potential functional support. The overall aesthetic is minimalist yet substantial, emphasizing material and form.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Armchair with Dark Wood Frame
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a robust, rectilinear dark brown wooden frame with a high-gloss finish. The chair is viewed from a slight angle, showcasing its depth and solid construction.

name: Armless Lounge Chair with Sled Base
description: A low-profile, armless lounge chair featuring a camel-colored upholstered seat and back, set within a dark, possibly mahogany or wenge-toned, solid wood or laminate base. The backrest is gently curved, and the base forms continuous, broad sled-like supports on the sides and back, providing a robust and grounded appearance.

description: A contemporary dining armchair featuring a curved wooden frame and upholstered seat and backrest, rendered against a white background.

description: A wooden outdoor bench featuring an integrated tall slatted backrest. The bench itself is a storage box with a slatted top that serves as a seat. description: A modern, armless lounge chair module featuring a dark grey frame and light grey upholstered cushions for both the seat and backrest.

name: Velvet Channel Tufted Dining Chair with Tapered Brass-Capped Legs
description: A single upholstered chair featuring a curved, channel-tufted velvet backrest and a round velvet seat, supported by four slender, tapered black legs with brass-finished tips.

description: A contemporary, sculptural accent chair featuring a high, wavy upholstered backrest and an integrated circular wooden side table. description: A modern armchair featuring a black frame, a black upholstered seat, and a natural cane backrest, presented against a white background.

description: A round, plush upholstered swivel lounge chair with extensive fabric ruching, resting on a circular chrome base.

description: A modern armless side chair featuring a sleek red fabric upholstered seat and back, supported by a minimalist black metal sled base frame. The design emphasizes clean lines and functional simplicity.

description: An armless dining chair featuring a polished chrome cantilever frame and cream-colored upholstered seat and backrest. The design is minimalist and modern, with rounded, padded cushions.

description: A contemporary grey upholstered accent chair with a rounded, bucket-style seat and backrest featuring horizontal channel tufting, supported by four slender splayed black metal legs.

description: A Mid-Century Modern style armchair featuring a wooden frame and gray fabric upholstery. The chair has four tapered wooden legs. name: Mid-Century Modern Upholstered Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary dining armchair featuring a solid wooden frame and soft bouclé upholstery. The chair has a rounded backrest, a padded seat, and slender, tapered wooden legs. description: A contemporary, armless lounge chair constructed from a single piece of molded terracotta-colored plastic. It features a monolithic, sculptural form with smooth, rounded edges and an integrated base, creating a seamless and inviting ergonomic seat.

name: Traditional Leather Club Chair
description: A dark brown leather upholstered armchair, viewed from the rear. It features a tall, rounded backrest, suggesting a comfortable and classic design. The sides show a glimpse of the rounded armrests, and the chair is supported by small, square block feet.

name: Modern Bentwood and Fabric Counter Stool
description: An armless modern counter stool featuring a light-toned bentwood frame with a curved, sculptural design and upholstered seat and backrest in a neutral fabric. It includes an integrated dark footrest bar.

name: Cylindrical Channel-Tufted Ottoman with Brass Base
description: A contemporary cylindrical ottoman featuring plush channel-tufted upholstery in a neutral cream color, supported by a sleek metallic plinth base.

description: A long, rectangular bench featuring a deeply channel-tufted upholstered seat set upon a minimalist wooden frame with tapered legs. The upholstery is a rich green velvet-like fabric adorned with a light-colored chevron pattern.

name: Transitional Skirted Upholstered Armchair
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a high, subtly curved backrest, rolled armrests, and a skirted base. The chair is covered in a light beige fabric with a woven geometric diamond pattern. The skirt of the base is gathered with pleats.

name: Contemporary Green Upholstered Swivel Armchair
description: A contemporary swivel chair featuring a circular upholstered seat and curved backrest in dark green, supported by a polished brass pedestal base.

description: A bright red metal stool featuring a circular seat with a perforated pattern. The stool has four slender legs that splay slightly outwards, connected by a circular footrest ring. Black rubber caps are present on the feet.

name: Traditional Floral Upholstered Settee
description: A traditional style settee featuring a dark stained wooden frame with turned legs and spindle back/arm supports. The seat cushion is upholstered in a solid, light beige fabric with button tufting, while the low back and armrests are covered in a multi-colored floral pattern fabric, predominantly featuring red, green, and cream tones. Nailhead trim accents the bottom edge of the seat.

name: Contemporary Office Guest Chair
description: A contemporary office guest chair featuring brown upholstered seat and backrest, supported by a polished chrome or silver-finished metal frame. The backrest is horizontally ribbed, and the chair includes integrated armrests with padded tops. The legs are slender and straight, suggesting a fixed-base design.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered chair featuring a curved, enveloping backrest and integrated armrests. The chair is covered in a warm, reddish-brown fabric, possibly velvet or a similar plush material, which shows some gathered detailing on the inner backrest. It rests on four slender, angled, dark-colored metal legs. The design emphasizes comfort and a modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Dark Wood and Tan Leather Dining Chair
description: A modern dining chair featuring a robust dark-stained wooden frame with integrated minimalist armrests and upholstered seat and back in a warm tan leather. The design is characterized by its clean, geometric lines and substantial construction.

name: Woven Seagrass Floor Lounge Chair
description: A low-profile lounge chair constructed entirely from natural woven fibers, likely seagrass or jute. It features a seat and an integrated backrest, both covered in a dense, chunky weave, with the seating surface incorporating a finer, more intricate woven pattern. The chair is designed for floor-level lounging and has a warm, natural aesthetic.

name: Marble Pedestal Stool
description: A monolithic pedestal stool or side table crafted from veined marble. The cylindrical form features a flat top surface and a base with three or four arched cut-outs that create a sculptural, leg-like appearance. The marble displays natural variations in color, including shades of green, grey, white, and reddish-brown, with prominent swirling patterns.

name: Contemporary Wood and Rope Dining Chair
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring a dark wood frame with gracefully curved armrests that seamlessly integrate into the backrest. The backrest is composed of vertical, tightly-strung natural-toned rope weaving, offering a visually light and breathable element. The seat is upholstered in a rich, distressed brown leather cushion, providing a comfortable and contrasting texture. The chair is supported by four sturdy, tapered wooden legs.

name: Upholstered Tubular Metal Stool with Animal Print

name: Modern Upholstered Bucket Accent Chair

name: Ornate Carved Stone Garden Bench
description: An ornate, light-colored carved stone bench designed for outdoor use. It features an intricately carved backrest with floral and scroll motifs, flanked by decorative openwork armrests. The seat is solid, and the bench is supported by two substantial pedestal-style legs with curved, scrolled bases.

name: Contemporary Checkerboard Upholstered Accent Chair

It has a round, cushioned seat and a uniquely curved, kidney-shaped backrest. The chair is supported by four slender, tapered legs made of dark-stained wood, giving it a playful yet stylish aesthetic suitable for various modern interiors.

name: Modern Black Spindle-Back Windsor Dining Chair
description: A modern take on a classic Windsor-style dining chair, rendered entirely in black. name: Fully Upholstered Armless Slipper Chair
description: A fully upholstered single seating unit, resembling a slipper chair or compact bench. It features a low, gently curved backrest that seamlessly transitions into the seat. name: Ornate Wrought Iron Vanity Stool
description: An ornate wrought iron vanity stool featuring a round upholstered seat and an intricately scrolled frame that forms both the backrest and the legs. The metal frame is dark, likely black, complementing the light beige seat cushion.

name: Modern Upholstered Swivel Desk Chair with Rolled Backrest
description: A contemporary swivel desk chair featuring a distinctive backrest composed of two stacked, horizontally upholstered tubular elements in a vibrant orange fabric. The circular seat is upholstered in a contrasting dark blue fabric. The chair is supported by a light-colored, possibly wooden or painted metal, curved frame that connects the seat and backrest. name: Modern White Textured Bean Bag Chair with Green Accent Cushion
description: A large, round, off-white bean bag chair with a textured fabric finish, featuring a small, square sage green accent cushion placed in its center.

description: A contemporary armchair featuring a bucket-style seat and backrest meticulously hand-woven from natural beige rope with striking black accent stripes. The supportive frame consists of four slightly splayed, light-toned wooden legs.

name: Contemporary Velvet Single-Arm Accent Chair
description: An upholstered accent chair featuring a single integrated armrest and a deep, plush seat. The design is contemporary with soft, rounded edges throughout, covered in a camel-colored velvet-like fabric. The chair has a substantial, block-like base, contributing to its modern and inviting aesthetic.

name: Modern Curved Blue Velvet Armless Chair
description: A modern, low-profile accent chair featuring a distinctive curved silhouette, fully upholstered in a rich blue velvet fabric. name: Contemporary Dark Wood Bench with Sculpted Rolled Ends
description: A minimalist dark brown wood bench featuring a long, rectangular seat with distinctively sculpted, upward-curving rolled ends. The seat is supported by two thick, cylindrical or half-cylindrical legs, providing a sturdy and clean aesthetic. The wood displays a prominent grain pattern and a smooth, polished finish.

name: Contemporary Navy Blue Wingback Armchair with Nailhead Trim
description: A contemporary wingback armchair featuring deep navy blue textured fabric upholstery. The chair has a dramatically tall backrest with pronounced, elegantly curved wings and track arms, all accentuated by a continuous line of polished metal nailhead trim.

name: Pink Velvet Scalloped Swivel Accent Chair
description: A stylish accent chair featuring a barrel-shaped design with a distinctive scalloped backrest and armrests, upholstered in a soft pink velvet fabric. The chair sits on a round, polished brass swivel base, offering both functionality and a touch of glamour.

name: Contemporary Barrel Accent Chair with Two-Tone Upholstery
description: A contemporary barrel-shaped accent chair featuring a sophisticated two-tone upholstery. The inner seating area and back are covered in a smooth, light cream or off-white fabric, providing a sleek appearance. The outer shell, including the integrated arms and base, is upholstered in a contrasting textured fabric, likely a linen or bouclé blend, in a light beige or natural tone. The chair has a low profile with no visible legs, contributing to its modern and sculptural aesthetic. Its rounded form offers a comfortable, embracing feel.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Modular Armless Chair
description: A contemporary modular armless chair, upholstered in a textured, plush fabric of a warm, earthy camel-brown color. The unit features a low-profile design with a solid base and a separate, soft seat cushion. The backrest is gently curved and incorporates horizontal channel tufting, providing both aesthetic detail and ergonomic support. Its armless construction allows for versatile placement, either as a standalone accent piece or as part of a larger modular seating arrangement.

name: Contemporary Ribbed Upholstery Accent Chair
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a low, rounded backrest that seamlessly transitions into integrated armrests. The chair has a circular seat cushion, and both the backrest/armrests and seat are upholstered in a textured, ribbed fabric in a burnt orange or terracotta hue. It is supported by four slender, cylindrical metal legs with a polished chrome or silver finish.

name: Mid-Century Modern Wood Frame Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary or mid-century modern style lounge chair featuring a prominent exposed dark wood frame and upholstered cushions in a light gray fabric. The chair has a low profile with an angled backrest and splayed legs, offering a comfortable and stylish seating option.

name: French Provincial Upholstered Bench
description: A French Provincial style upholstered bench featuring a rectangular padded seat covered in a patterned fabric, supported by a wooden frame with elegant cabriole legs.

name: Rattan Swivel Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary swivel armchair featuring a curved dark brown frame, likely rattan or bentwood, and plush cream-colored upholstered cushions. The chair has a circular base enabling 360-degree rotation.

name: Rounded Corduroy Accent Chair
description: A single-seater upholstered accent chair featuring a distinctive rounded and cohesive silhouette. The chair is entirely covered in a ribbed, corduroy-like fabric in a rich burnt orange color, giving it a soft texture. It has integrated, gently curving armrests and backrest that form a continuous profile. The base is low and minimally exposed, contributing to its compact and modern aesthetic.

name: French Provincial Upholstered Armchair
description: An elegant French Provincial style armchair featuring a visible, ornate carved wooden frame and light-colored fabric upholstery. The chair has a curved backrest, open arms with scrolled details, and cabriole legs, indicative of its classic design. It includes a loose seat cushion and a loose back cushion, both upholstered in a neutral linen-like fabric.

name: Upholstered Dark Wood Bar Stool with Bolster Back
description: A contemporary bar stool featuring a sturdy dark wood frame, an amply padded upholstered seat cushion, and a distinctive cylindrical bolster backrest. The seat is covered in a plush, light brown/tan fabric, while the backrest is upholstered in a contrasting fabric with a geometric or abstract pattern in darker tones. name: Modern Curved Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair distinguished by its deep, organically curved seat and a low, supportive backrest, both generously upholstered in a rich, dark olive green plush fabric. The chair's fluid lines suggest comfort and a relaxed posture. It is supported by a sturdy, dark-stained wooden base featuring four subtly tapered legs, which complement the chair's sophisticated aesthetic. The design emphasizes soft forms and tactile comfort, making it an inviting piece of modern furniture.

name: Modern Walnut and Leather Bar Stool
description: A modern bar stool featuring a dark walnut wood frame, a padded medium-brown leather seat, and a minimalist backrest. The design incorporates a copper-finished footrest and copper caps on the front legs, suggesting contemporary elegance.

name: Contemporary Channel Tufted Velvet Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a dark olive green velvet fabric, vertical channel tufting on the exterior backrest, and slender black metal legs with brass-finished tips. The chair has a curved, enveloping back and armrest design.

name: Contemporary Tubular Back Accent Chair
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a distinctive tubular, curved backrest and a circular padded seat, all upholstered in a textured terracotta-colored fabric. The chair is supported by four slender black metal legs.

name: Dark Green Leatherette Armless Club Chair
description: A contemporary armless club chair upholstered in a dark green leatherette material. The chair features a compact, integrated design with a tall, gently curved backrest and a square seat, both fully upholstered. The base is a solid, rectangular block, creating a seamless and sturdy appearance. The overall aesthetic is minimalist with a touch of retro charm, characterized by its rounded edges and cohesive form.

name: Organic Modern Upholstered Dining Chair
description: An organic modern dining chair featuring a fully upholstered, organically shaped seat and back in a light, neutral fabric, supported by four tapered dark wood legs. The chair has a sleek, minimalist profile with no visible arms.

name: Wooden Upholstered Dining Chair
description: A classic wooden dining chair featuring an upholstered seat and backrest. The frame is constructed from a light-to-medium brown wood, likely oak, with a smooth finish. The legs are straight and sturdy, with horizontal stretchers connecting them for added stability.

name: Woven Rattan and Chrome Frame Lounge Chair
description: A modern lounge chair featuring a chrome-plated tubular steel frame and a woven rattan or synthetic wicker seat and back. The design incorporates a sled-style base for stability and integrated armrests with woven details, offering a sleek, relaxed aesthetic.

name: Neoclassical Empire Chaise Lounge
description: An elegant chaise lounge featuring a distinct Neoclassical Empire style. It rests on short, gently curved saber legs, showcasing a blend of classical influences and refined craftsmanship.

name: Organic Modern Boucle Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a sculpted, dark wood frame and plush, cream-colored boucle upholstery. name: Mid-Century Modern Upholstered Armchair

The seat and backrest are padded and upholstered in a light, textured fabric, likely off-white or cream. The armrests are integrated into the frame, providing support for the upholstered arm pads. name: Traditional Turned-Wood Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: A classic-style dining chair crafted from dark brown wood, featuring turned elements on the legs and back supports, and a comfortably upholstered circular seat in a light beige fabric.

name: Minimalist Interlocking Wood Lounge Chair
description: A minimalist wooden chair, constructed from interlocking flat panels. name: Contemporary Upholstered Dining Armchair

description: A modern dining chair featuring a curved bentwood backrest with a central horizontal cutout functioning as a handle. name: Contemporary Two-Tone Wood Bouclé Dining Armchair
description: A contemporary dining armchair featuring a distinctive two-tone wooden frame and bouclé upholstery. description: A contemporary bench featuring a rectangular form with a black tubular metal frame and an intricately woven natural fiber seat, likely cane or rattan, in a light beige color. The frame has clean lines and subtle rounded corners.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Upholstered Chaise Lounge
description: An elegant, contemporary chaise lounge featuring an organic, curvilinear form upholstered in a dark brown fabric, resting on a circular natural wood plinth base. It has a distinct headrest section that curves upwards, providing support.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Cane Armchair
description: A traditional dark wood armchair featuring a cane woven backrest and seat. The chair has elegantly curved armrests and turned front legs, with saber-style back legs, indicative of a classic or colonial design.

name: Contemporary Scalloped Velvet Accent Chair
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a distinctive scalloped, shell-like backrest upholstered in deep blue velvet. The chair is supported by slender, tapered metal legs with a polished brass finish. The sides of the chair include panels adorned with a vibrant, multi-colored abstract or floral pattern, providing a visual contrast to the solid velvet.

name: Channel-Tufted Barrel Accent Chair with Plinth Base
description: A contemporary barrel-shaped accent chair, fully upholstered in a textured beige fabric with distinct vertical channel tufting on the backrest and outer arms, supported by a low, dark wooden plinth base.

name: Mid-Century Modern Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: An armless dining chair featuring a warm walnut-toned wooden frame and an upholstered seat with a green fabric adorned with a white abstract pattern. The chair exhibits clean lines, tapered legs, and a gently curved backrest with a distinctive cut-out detail.

name: Minimalist Light Wood Round Stool
description: A light-toned, minimalist wooden stool featuring a round seat with a subtle handle cutout and four cylindrical legs. The legs are integrated directly into the underside of the seat, creating a clean and cohesive design. The wood grain is visible, indicating a natural finish.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Dining/Accent Chair
description: A contemporary upholstered chair featuring a curved, bucket-style seat and backrest, covered in a textured grey fabric. The chair is supported by four slender, black metal hairpin legs that splay outwards for stability. The design is sleek and minimalist, suitable for various modern interior settings.

name: Baroque Revival Carved Wood Wingback Armchair with Tartan Upholstery and Leather Accents
description: A highly decorative and traditional wingback armchair featuring an exposed carved wooden frame, tartan plaid fabric upholstery on the seat and back, and black leather accents on the outer back and armrests, all finished with brass nailhead trim. The chair has prominent cabriole legs and scrolled details indicative of Baroque or Rococo revival styles.

name: Modern Rounded Upholstered Accent Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a plush, rounded silhouette and thick cushioning, finished in a textured rust-red fabric. The chair has fully upholstered arms and back, with visible stitched seams that define its soft, inviting form. It rests on four short, cylindrical wooden feet, contributing to its low-profile and substantial appearance. The design emphasizes comfort and a soft, modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Black Stained Wood Bench with Arched Supports
description: A minimalist, modern bench crafted from black stained wood, featuring a thick rectangular top supported by two robust, U-shaped arched legs. The wood exhibits a visible grain and textured finish, giving it a raw yet refined appearance. The design emphasizes sculptural form and substantial presence.

name: Transitional Cream Upholstered Armchair with Turned Wood Details and Botanical Patterned Back
description: A stylish armchair featuring an exposed dark wood frame, light cream upholstery, and a distinctive patterned outer backrest. The design combines classic turned wood elements with modern curves, creating a transitional aesthetic. A decorative throw pillow with a botanical leaf pattern is included.

name: Modernist Tubular Chrome and Leather Bench
description: A modernist bench featuring a polished tubular chrome frame and a thick, rectangular cushion upholstered in distressed brown leather. The minimalist design emphasizes clean lines and industrial materials, offering a sleek and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Upholstered Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary upholstered lounge chair featuring a distinctive sculptural form. The chair is fully covered in a light-colored, textured fabric, presenting a unified and organic silhouette. It comprises a rounded seat and back with integrated armrests, resting on a wide, tapered cylindrical base.

name: Art Deco Club Armchair with Exposed Wood Frame
description: An Art Deco inspired armchair featuring plush, terracotta brown velvet upholstery and a distinctive dark stained exposed wooden frame that forms the curved armrests and outlines the sides. It stands on four short, fluted bun feet.

name: Light Oak Armrest Bar Stool with Upholstered Seat
description: A modern armrest bar stool constructed from light-colored solid wood, featuring an integrated backrest and armrests. The seat is upholstered in a light beige or tan material, likely fabric or leatherette. The design is minimalist with clean lines, and the frame includes horizontal stretchers that serve as footrests. The wood grain is visible, indicating a natural finish.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Accent Chair with Curved Backrest
description: A compact, contemporary accent chair featuring a circular upholstered seat and a continuous, curved upholstered backrest that doubles as partial arm support. The chair is supported by four slender, straight black metal legs. The upholstery is a light beige or cream-colored textured fabric, contributing to its minimalist and modern aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Light Blue Boucle Chaise Lounge with Bolster Armrest
description: A contemporary chaise lounge upholstered in a light blue, textured boucle fabric. It features a single rounded, cylindrical bolster armrest on the left side and a backrest that extends approximately two-thirds of the length, leaving the right side open. The chaise lounge rests on four short, cylindrical legs that are also fully upholstered in the matching fabric, creating a cohesive and minimalist design. Its overall aesthetic is soft and inviting, suitable for modern interiors.

name: Contemporary Bouclé Upholstered Dining Chair
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring a fully upholstered, curved back and seat in a cream-colored bouclé fabric, supported by four splayed wooden legs with a natural light finish.

name: Distressed Leather Industrial Accent Chair
description: An accent chair featuring a dark gray distressed leather upholstery and an open, geometric metal frame with a bronze finish. The chair has a padded seat, backrest, and armrests with leather strapping details.

name: Modern Wood Frame Lounge Chair with Round Back Cushion
description: A modern lounge chair featuring a light natural wood frame, a rectangular seat cushion, and a distinctive circular back cushion, all upholstered in a cream-colored textured fabric. The wooden frame has gently curved armrests and an open slatted backrest.

name: Modern Upholstered Dining Armchair with Dark Wood Legs
description: A modern upholstered armchair featuring a subtly curved back and integrated armrests, set on elegantly splayed dark wood legs. The chair is covered in a light, textured fabric, giving it a contemporary and inviting appearance.

name: Traditional Upholstered Wingback Armchair
description: A classic wingback armchair featuring light beige upholstered fabric, deep button tufting on the backrest, and antique brass nailhead trim along the armrests and base. The chair is supported by four dark, curved wooden legs.

name: Traditional Carved Wooden Dining Chair with Floral Upholstery
description: A traditional wooden dining chair featuring a carved crest rail and decorative elements on the backrest. The seat and backrest panel are upholstered in a cream-colored fabric with an intricate floral and scroll pattern in muted tones of pink, green, and gold. The chair's frame is a warm brown wood, with elegantly curved cabriole front legs and straight square rear legs, connected by stretchers for stability. The overall design evokes a classic, ornate aesthetic suitable for formal dining settings.

name: Ornate Traditional Carved Wood Armchair with Damask Upholstery
description: An ornate traditional armchair featuring a medium-dark brown wooden frame with extensive carving. The chair has a tall back with a prominent carved crest rail and scrollwork. The arms are substantial, featuring a scrolled design at the front. The seat and backrest are upholstered in a light cream or beige fabric with a light gold damask pattern. The front legs are cabriole style with shell carving near the top, and the chair's overall aesthetic evokes classical or Rococo-inspired design.

name: Modern Solid Wood Bench with Contoured Seats
description: A long, low wooden bench featuring three distinct, subtly curved seating sections made from light-toned wood. The legs and support structure are also crafted from the same wood, forming a continuous, organic-shaped base, giving it a minimalist yet sculptural appearance.

name: Low-back Wooden Frame Leather Sling Accent Chair
description: A low-back accent chair featuring a light-toned wooden frame and brown leather sling seat and backrest. The leather elements are secured to the frame with visible dark metal fasteners, creating a sturdy, minimalist aesthetic. The chair has a simple, block-like wooden construction with straight legs and stretchers.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Swivel Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair featuring a dark, rounded frame with brass vertical spindle accents, light gray fabric cushions, and a fluted conical swivel base with a gold-toned trim.

name: Modern Wood-Framed Lounge Chair
description: A modern lounge chair featuring a dark-stained open wood frame and thick, light-colored upholstered cushions. The frame forms both the legs and armrests, creating a clean, architectural silhouette. The back cushion is separate from the seat cushion, and both are well-padded, suggesting comfort. The chair is photographed against a white background, highlighting its form and minimalist aesthetic.

name: Regency Style Chaise Lounge
description: An elegant Regency-style chaise lounge featuring a distinctive rolled backrest, a single armrest with baluster detailing, and classic striped fabric upholstery over an exposed wooden frame.

name: Contemporary Grey Fabric Tub Armchair
description: A contemporary grey fabric upholstered armchair with a rounded barrel-style back and integrated armrests, featuring a compact design and splayed black metal legs. The upholstery has a fine, textured weave.

name: Industrial Style Entryway Bench with Coat Rack
description: An industrial-style entryway hall tree featuring a light-toned wooden bench seat, a black metal frame, and an integrated coat rack with multiple hooks. The design is minimalist and functional.

name: Rustic Reclaimed Wood Bench
description: A rustic, rectangular bench crafted from dark, distressed reclaimed wood. It features a thick, solid plank top supported by two sturdy A-frame leg structures, connected by a crossbar. The wood exhibits natural imperfections, grain variations, and visible signs of age, contributing to its rugged aesthetic. The construction appears robust with simple, exposed joinery.

name: Modern Bentwood Swivel Bar Stool with Upholstered Seat and Back
description: A modern bar stool featuring a light-toned bentwood frame, an upholstered seat and back, and a chrome footrest. The design is characterized by its curved forms and clean lines, with a swivel function.

name: Contemporary Organic Bouclé Lounge Chair
description: A contemporary lounge chair featuring a distinctive, organic form, fully upholstered in a textured, light beige bouclé fabric. The chair's structure is composed of rounded, curvilinear shapes that form the base, seat, back, and integrated armrests, creating a cohesive and sculptural silhouette. Its low profile suggests a relaxed seating experience.

name: Upholstered Swivel Office Chair with Armrests
description: A contemporary swivel office chair featuring olive green textured fabric upholstery on both the seat and backrest. It has integrated loop-style armrests made of polished metal. The chair is supported by a five-star base with casters, also in polished metal, and includes a visible lever for height adjustment. The design emphasizes a functional yet stylish aesthetic suitable for modern workspaces.

name: Contemporary Sculptural Dark Wood Upholstered Accent Chair
description: A contemporary, low-profile accent chair featuring a sculptural dark wood frame with a contrasting light upholstered seat. The chair's design is characterized by thick, curved wooden panels forming the seat, backrest, and base, with visible wood grain. The base consists of two substantial, angled supports with a central vertical cut-out, creating a distinctive and stable structure. The upholstered seat pad is light-colored, offering a visual contrast to the dark wood.

name: Dark Stained Wood Bar Stool with Carved Backrest
description: A sturdy, dark stained wood bar stool featuring a distinctive backrest with a scalloped top edge and three circular cutouts. The stool has a square, flat seat and four robust, round legs connected by integrated footrests for stability. Its construction suggests solid wood craftsmanship.

name: Vintage Chrome Cantilever Lounge Chair with Tufted Brown Velvet Cushions
description: A low-slung lounge chair featuring a polished chrome tubular cantilever frame, supporting thick, plush brown velvet cushions. The seat and back cushions are generously padded and tufted, providing a comfortable and relaxed seating experience. The design suggests a vintage aesthetic, likely from the 1970s or 1980s.

name: Modern Upholstered Side Chair with Metal Legs
description: An armless side chair featuring a blue upholstered seat and backrest, supported by slender blue tubular metal legs. The chair has a modern and minimalist design with gently curved contours.

name: Plaid Upholstered Swivel Armchair with Plinth Base
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a contemporary design with a classic plaid pattern. The chair has a boxy, fully upholstered frame with wide, slightly flared block arms and a straight back. It includes a loose seat cushion and a loose back cushion, both upholstered in the same plaid fabric. The chair rests on a visible wooden plinth base, which likely incorporates a swivel mechanism for rotational movement.

name: Two-Tone Contemporary Chaise Lounge
description: A contemporary chaise lounge featuring a two-tone upholstery design. The extended seat and single curved backrest are upholstered in a light gray textured fabric, while the base and exterior of the backrest are covered in a contrasting brown material, possibly faux leather or suede. It includes two toss pillows, one of which has a decorative brown strap accent. The lounge rests on four tapered, dark-stained wooden legs, giving it a sleek and modern appearance.

name: Modern Upholstered Chaise Lounge with Wood Base
description: A modern chaise lounge featuring dark fabric upholstery, a curved headrest, and a unique cylindrical armrest secured with leather straps and brass hardware, all supported by a dark, possibly ribbed, wood base.

name: Themed Decorative Side Chair
description: A brown, armless side chair with a slightly reclined backrest featuring golden decorative motifs and the text 'HES POLADE' on the top rail. The chair has a square seat with small golden corner details and four sturdy, tapered legs. The material appears to be molded plastic or a composite, simulating wood.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Barrel Back Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a solid dark wood frame and mixed upholstery. The backrest and integrated arms form a curved barrel shape, upholstered in a textured, light brown and off-white tweed-like fabric. The seat cushion is upholstered in a lighter, off-white fabric with subtle vertical stripes. The frame consists of four tapered legs and features distinctive turned wooden details at the top of the front leg supports, where they meet the armrests.

name: Contemporary Barrel Armchair with Houndstooth Upholstery
description: A modern armchair featuring a curved, solid-colored outer shell in a tan/orange hue, with the interior upholstered in a black and white houndstooth fabric. It stands on slender, gold-finished metal legs and has a matching gold-toned trim around its base.

name: Contemporary Powered Home Theater Recliner
description: A single-seat, contemporary powered recliner upholstered in beige leatherette, featuring integrated cup holders, illuminated control buttons on the armrest, and subtle ambient lighting along the base. The chair has a plush, segmented design with horizontal channel stitching on the seat and backrest, and includes a small black accent pillow.

name: Natural Wood Cross-Back Dining Chair with Upholstered Seat
description: A light-colored wooden chair featuring a distinctive cross-back design and an upholstered seat. The frame appears to be constructed from bentwood, providing a classic, slightly curved profile. The backrest consists of a curved top rail and two intersecting wooden slats forming an 'X' shape. The seat cushion is upholstered in a light, textured fabric, likely linen or a blend, in an off-white or light grey hue. The chair has four slender legs, with the rear legs extending upwards to form part of the back support. This design is commonly associated with bistro or farmhouse aesthetics.

name: Wooden Frame Leather Upholstered Bar Stool with Armrests
description: A contemporary bar stool featuring a dark-stained solid wood frame and upholstered in rich cognac-colored leather. It has a square, architectural silhouette with integrated armrests and a gently curved backrest. The base includes horizontal stretchers that serve as footrests.

name: Contemporary Bouclé Dining Chair with Metal Legs
description: A contemporary dining chair featuring an off-white bouclé upholstered seat and backrest, supported by slender, splayed metal legs with a champagne finish. The backrest is gently curved and seamlessly integrates into short armrests.

name: Arts and Crafts Bentwood Side Chair with Studded Leather Seat
description: A dark brown wooden side chair featuring a tall, arching bentwood backrest with a central vertical support adorned with decorative ball finials. The seat is upholstered in dark brown leather, secured with visible metal studs. It stands on four cylindrical wooden legs, with spherical elements connecting the front legs to the seat frame.

name: Modern Upholstered Dining Chair with Splayed Metal Legs
description: A modern upholstered dining chair featuring a single, contoured shell seat and back, supported by a splayed, four-leg metallic base.

name: Stacking Metal Stool with Round White Seat
description: A modern, round stacking stool featuring a white plastic or laminate seat and four polished metal legs that curve inward, allowing for vertical stacking. Each leg is fitted with a black protective foot cap.

name: Sculptural Art Deco Revival Vanity Chair
description: A highly sculptural chair featuring a round, cushioned seat and a corresponding round, cushioned backrest, both upholstered in a light cream material. The chair's frame is constructed from richly polished dark wood, possibly a burl veneer, exhibiting a high-gloss finish. The base is notably asymmetrical, with one side supported by stacked polished wooden spheres and the other by a broad, curved, flat wooden panel that extends upwards to form part of the backrest support.

name: Modern Upholstered Wood Bar Stool
description: A modern bar stool featuring a circular upholstered seat and a low, curved backrest, set atop four dark brown, tapered wooden legs with a circular footrest ring. The upholstery is a light, cream-colored fabric with a subtle texture.

name: Mid-Century Solid Wood Bench with Raised Ends
description: A rectangular wooden bench featuring a minimalist design, splayed tapered legs, and subtle raised elements at each end, indicative of Mid-Century Modern aesthetics.

name: Modern Armless Side Chair with Tiger Print Upholstery
description: A modern armless side chair featuring a distinctive tiger print upholstered seat and back. The frame is constructed from bent metal tubing with a dark red finish, forming a continuous structure for the legs and support.

name: Modern Cane and Wood Accent Chair with Upholstered Cushions
description: A contemporary accent chair featuring a natural light wood frame, cane webbing on the curved back and armrests, and plush upholstered cushions in an off-white fabric, accompanied by two decorative throw pillows.

name: Contemporary Upholstered Armchair with Patterned Back
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a dark wood frame with a curved, barrel-style backrest upholstered in a rich, multi-colored patterned fabric. The seat cushion is a deep red velvet, providing a contrast to the back. The wooden legs are tapered and finished with elegant brass caps. The armrests are solid wood, smoothly integrated into the frame.

name: Transitional Barrel Armchair with Wooden Trim
description: An upholstered armchair featuring a rounded barrel back, integrated arms with exposed dark wood trim, and turned wooden legs.

name: Modern Blue Upholstered Bar Stool with Backrest
description: A modern bar stool featuring a bright blue tubular metal frame and matching blue upholstered seat and backrest. The design is minimalist, with a padded square seat and a small rectangular backrest, both covered in a textured fabric. The frame includes a square-shaped footrest for comfort and stability, reflecting a monochromatic and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Postmodern Sculptural Wave Lounge Chair
description: A striking purple lounge chair featuring a continuous, sculptural wave-like form. The chair is entirely upholstered in a textured fabric, presenting a seamless, legless design that serves as both seat and backrest, characteristic of avant-garde furniture.

name: Contemporary Dark Wood Dining Chair with Cane Back and Upholstered Seat
description: A contemporary dark wood dining chair featuring a gracefully curved frame, a woven cane backrest, and a plush white upholstered seat. The chair's legs are tapered, and the backrest slightly extends forward to provide subtle arm support.

name: Mid-Century Modern Swivel Lounge Chair
description: A classic Mid-Century Modern lounge chair featuring a distinctive bent plywood shell, rich tan leather upholstery, and a polished metal swivel base. The chair has three distinct upholstered sections: a padded headrest, a backrest, and a seat cushion, all button-tufted. Integrated armrests are also upholstered in matching leather. The dark wood veneer of the plywood contrasts elegantly with the light brown leather and the black and silver star base.

name: Contemporary Boucle Swivel Barrel Chair
description: A modern, upholstered swivel chair featuring a rounded, barrel-back silhouette and a deeply cushioned seat, covered in a cream-colored, textured boucle fabric. It includes a small, rectangular throw pillow in a similar muted tone and rests on a low-profile, wood-finish swivel base, allowing for 360-degree rotation.

name: Modern Contoured Wooden Bench
description: A modern bench featuring a distinctively contoured, wavy seat made from dark reddish-brown wood. The bench has a minimalist design with integrated rectangular legs, forming a single, seamless structure.

name: Minimalist Beige Oval Bench with Cylindrical Legs
description: A minimalist, modern bench featuring an elongated oval top and three thick, cylindrical legs with rounded bases, all rendered in a matte beige finish. The design emphasizes soft curves and a monolithic appearance.

name: Mid-Century Modern Button-Tufted Lounge Chair
description: A high-back upholstered lounge chair featuring button tufting, a contoured seat and back, and splayed wooden legs. The upholstery is a muted taupe color, indicative of a modern or mid-century aesthetic.

name: Ergonomic Mesh Office Chair with Headrest
description: A modern ergonomic office chair in black, featuring a breathable mesh backrest and adjustable headrest, a padded fabric seat, and a five-star wheeled base. It has adjustable armrests and seat height adjustment levers.

name: Contemporary Swivel Armchair with Barrel Back
description: A contemporary swivel lounge chair with a barrel-style back and integrated arms, upholstered in a rich, rust-colored velvet fabric. The chair features curved wooden panels on the inner arms and rests on a solid cylindrical wooden base, suggesting a swivel mechanism.

name: Contemporary Armless Upholstered Dining Chair
description: An armless dining chair featuring a dark wood frame and fully upholstered seat and backrest. The upholstery is a light beige textured fabric. The backrest has a gentle curve and rounded top, while the legs are straight and slightly tapered, extending from the seat base. The chair exhibits clean, minimalist lines suitable for modern or transitional interiors.

name: Contemporary Bent Plywood and Metal Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a single piece of bent light wood veneer forming the seat and back, supported by a minimalist tubular metal frame in a dark red color. The frame includes four straight legs and curved armrests that follow the contour of the seat. The chair exhibits a clean, modern aesthetic.

name: High-Back Wooden Armchair with Woven Rope Seat and Backrest
description: A high-back armchair constructed from dark wood with a distinct woven rope seat and backrest. The backrest features a striking checkered pattern of open spaces and tightly woven natural fiber sections. The chair has straight wooden armrests and a sturdy, minimalist frame.

name: Colonial Style Cane Seat Armchair
description: A dark wood armchair featuring a classic design with a woven cane seat and gently curved armrests. The backrest consists of vertical slats, and the chair frame is crafted from solid wood, suggesting a traditional or colonial aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Chunky Velvet Armchair
description: A contemporary upholstered armchair in a rich brown velvet fabric, characterized by its substantial, rounded, and monolithic silhouette. The design features a continuous back and armrest structure, creating a C-shaped profile that flows into thick, rounded legs. The seat cushion appears integrated into the overall form, providing a clean, cohesive appearance.

name: Modern Sculptural Tubular Armchair
description: A contemporary armchair featuring a distinctive sculptural design with thick, tubular, rounded elements that form the legs, armrests, and backrest. The entire chair is fully upholstered in a muted olive green fabric, giving it a monolithic and soft appearance. The seat is an integrated, circular upholstered cushion, contributing to the chair's overall plush and organic aesthetic.

name: Classic Upholstered Armchair with Nailhead Trim
description: A classic-style armchair featuring a dark wood frame with a curved top rail and a distinctive semi-circular cutout. The seat and backrest are upholstered in a light, neutral-toned fabric, accented by extensive nailhead trim along the edges. The chair includes padded armrests integrated into the wooden frame, and the back of the backrest features a subtle decorative pattern in a similar muted tone.

name: Modern Wooden Armchair with Woven Backrest
description: A modern armchair constructed with a light-colored solid wood frame, featuring a distinctive woven strap backrest and a padded, upholstered seat. The chair has integrated armrests and four tapered legs, presenting a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

name: Woven Ribbed Corduroy Cube Ottoman
description: A cube-shaped upholstered ottoman featuring a distinctive woven design created from wide, interlocking strips of ribbed corduroy fabric. The fabric is a warm terracotta or burnt orange color, and the ottoman rests on small, dark, low-profile feet.

name: Upholstered Armless Dining Chair with Metal Frame
description: An armless dining chair featuring light-colored, textured upholstery and a minimalist dark metal frame. The seat and backrest are amply padded, with the backrest presenting a gentle curve for ergonomic support. The four sturdy metal legs provide stable support.

name: Upholstered Scalloped Accent Chair with Stacked Ball Legs
description: An exquisitely designed accent chair, characterized by its distinctive scalloped edges and unique stacked ball legs. The high backrest and the chair's body are upholstered in a rich red jacquard fabric with a gold/beige floral pattern, highlighted by deep red piping. The front features a wavy, scalloped skirt detail. The circular seat cushion is upholstered in plain, deep maroon velvet. The chair stands on four dark, polished wooden supports, each composed of a stack of four spherical elements.

name: Rustic Trestle Wooden Bench
description: A rustic-style wooden bench featuring a rectangular top made of solid wood planks. The bench is supported by two X-shaped trestle bases, which are connected by a horizontal stretcher bar for added stability. The wood has a natural, light brown finish with visible grain, suggesting a robust and durable construction. The design is simple and functional, leaning towards a farmhouse or contemporary rustic aesthetic.
